label: An emitted anatomical blueprint graph is well-formed under its own rules
statement_en: For a finite graph of ontology terms with a body root, a level per node and part_of edges (part, whole): if every edge goes strictly down in level, every edge joins two nodes, and every non-root node has a whole, then part_of is acyclic (its transitive closure is transitive and strictly decreases the level, so nothing is part of itself) and every node reaches the root. With pinned taxon statements: no never_in_taxon on a kept term, a superclass or a whole names a taxon containing the blueprint taxon, and every in_taxon or stated_in_taxon names a containing taxon. A Boolean checker decides all of this, and its truth implies the well-formedness (wellFormed_of_check); each emitted blueprint gets a certificate the kernel evaluates by decide.

hypotheses.name: blueprint-well-formedness#assumed-2
hypotheses.statement: That the five levels (body, organ system, organ, tissue, cell) are the right notion of depth; the theorems use only that edges strictly decrease it.

hypotheses.name: blueprint-well-formedness#assumed-3
hypotheses.statement: Nothing about any organism: not that it is real, that the anatomy is correct or complete, that any part was measured, or anything about a transition between forms.

scope.basis: a theorem about a model: it applies wherever the design supplies the quantities it uses and accepts the hypotheses in scope.assumed
kernelChecked: Generic (any node type): edges strictly down in level ⟹ the part_of closure is transitive, strictly decreases the level, and is acyclic (Graph.acyclic_of_levelsDown, Graph.transGen_trans, Graph.transGen_level_lt).
Generic: edges closed and every non-root node has a whole ⟹ every node reaches the root (Graph.rooted_of, strong induction on level).
Generic: the Boolean checker is sound for LevelsDown, Closed, Acyclic, Rooted and the taxon conditions (wellFormed_of_check).

Per blueprint: the kernel evaluates the checker on the emitted graph and the pinned taxon rows (decide +kernel), and fixes the distinct-term counts per level and the graph size (lean/Delphi/Certificates/*.lean).
assumed: That Uberon and the Cell Ontology are correct and that Ubergraph served their part_of, subClassOf, never_in_taxon and in_taxon statements correctly and completely on the retrieval date: the graph and the taxon rows are data, pinned by hash and query.
That the five levels (body, organ system, organ, tissue, cell) are the right notion of depth; the theorems use only that edges strictly decrease it.
Nothing about any organism: not that it is real, that the anatomy is correct or complete, that any part was measured, or anything about a transition between forms.

lean.source:
/-- **Soundness of the checker.** If `check g D` evaluates to `true`, the graph is well-formed. -/
theorem wellFormed_of_check (g : Graph α) (D : TaxonData α τ) (h : check g D = true) : WellFormed g D := by
  unfold check at h
  have h1 := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h
  have h2 := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h1.1
  have h3 := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h2.1
  exact ⟨g.levelsDown_of_check h3.1, g.closed_of_check h3.2,
    g.acyclic_of_levelsDown (g.levelsDown_of_check h3.1), g.rooted_of_check h3.1 h3.2 h2.2,
    D.ok_of_check h1.2⟩

/-- A blueprint graph: nodes, a root, a level for each node, and `part_of` edges `(part, whole)`. -/
structure Graph (α : Type) where
  nodes : List α
  root : α
  level : α → ℕ
  partOf : List (α × α)

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.Blueprint.TaxonData
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- Taxon statements pinned from the ontology for one blueprint. `ancestors` are the taxa that contain
the blueprint's taxon (itself included); `neverIn` holds `(kept term, forbidden taxon)` for every
`never_in_taxon` statement on the term, a superclass or a whole; `inTaxon` holds `in_taxon` statements on
kept terms; `stated` holds the `stated_in_taxon` evidence the blueprint file itself records. -/
structure TaxonData (α τ : Type) where
  ancestors : List τ
  neverIn : List (α × τ)
  inTaxon : List (α × τ)
  stated : List (α × τ)
